## Changes since `v0.7.2-beta.1`

### Features

- search the groups page: a search box finds what the connections panel finds, by name, host, username or group, and keeps the tree with only the matches, so every group still shows and takes a drop; a group with no match folds and the others open, and folding one during a search lasts until the search changes without being saved; Select all ticks every match, and a ticked row the search hides is unticked so a drag or delete never takes rows out of sight; deleting a group during a search still counts all its connections in the confirmation ([89a50978](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/89a50978527b31612e65ce0cf0b7f8ce08c22c58))
- drag ticked connections together on the groups page: dragging a ticked row now carries every ticked row into the group or before the row it is dropped on, in the order they were listed, while an unticked row still moves alone; the carried rows fade and take no drops, and the dragged row shows how many it carries; the backend files the batch in one transaction with move_profiles_to_group, which replaces move_profile_to_group, and a drop that leaves the group's order as it was is not saved ([2aa9c0ba](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/2aa9c0ba3e71c636a033d456c0da474ae1d30755))
- show and edit nested profile groups: the connections panel lists groups as a tree with each level folding and counting the connections inside it, and a search or the recent order lists the connections flat with their group path; the groups page shows the tree as nested cards where a group gets subgroups in place and is dragged by its grip or name into another group, or onto the bar above the tree to move it to the top; while a group is dragged its own drop targets are off, since its card moves with the pointer and would catch the drop; the connection dialog takes a group path such as prod / web and suggests the existing ones in tree order ([692c37d6](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/692c37d6db6ac04d33abba218b3a7f3f02257e26))
- let profile groups nest: groups were bare names a profile carried, so they could not hold other groups and renaming one rewrote every profile in it; a group is now a record with an id, a name and a parent, and a profile points at its group by id; migration 12 keys each existing group by its old name, so two devices that upgrade apart agree on the ids and older sync files and backups still file profiles in their groups; deleting a group moves its profiles and groups up a level, a group cannot move into itself or a group inside it, and sibling names stay distinct and free of the / that separates a path; saving a profile with a group path such as prod / web creates the groups it names, which the SSH config import uses too; groups sync record by record, and after a sync or a restore the tree is mended: a group whose parent is gone moves to the top, a loop made by two devices is cut at its smallest id, and a profile in a deleted group becomes ungrouped ([5857bf88](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/5857bf889b91e14e1ec00cc5de4ac701f3d50cf8))

**Full comparison:** [v0.7.2-beta.1...v0.7.2-beta.2](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/compare/v0.7.2-beta.1...v0.7.2-beta.2)
